items.raw_excerpt: The pelt and skull of the last known thylacine are identified in Hobart, solving an 85-year mystery.
items.summary_en: The pelt and skull of the last known thylacine have been identified in a Hobart museum cupboard. The discovery solves an 85-year mystery about where the specimen was kept. The thylacine, also called the Tasmanian tiger, went extinct in 1936.

items.title_en: Last thylacine remains found in museum cupboard after 85 years

items.title_original: Tasmanian tiger: Remains of last thylacine found in cupboard after 85 years - BBC

items.raw_excerpt: Itâs an isolated province in an isolated part of the world but migrants from dozens of different countries call Taranaki home. Ash Muralidhar tells her story.
items.summary_en: Ash Muralidhar moved from a big city to Taranaki, a remote province in New Zealand. She now works as an environmental educator in a small town where migrants from dozens of countries have settled. Her story shows how people from faraway places build new lives in quiet corners of the world.
